en.headline: Two Kwun Tong flats burgled; 53-year-old man arrested nearby
en.dek: Police say three residents of Shun King Building on Ka Lok Street lost more than HK$47,000 after doors were forced on Thursday evening.
body: Police received a report at about 8 p.m. on Thursday that the door of a flat at Shun King Building, 17 to 33 Ka Lok Street in Kwun Tong, had been forced open and the unit ransacked, according to local reports citing officers at the scene.

A 52-year-old resident told police about HK$30,000 in cash, a gold necklace worth about HK$6,000 and a tablet computer worth about HK$5,000 were missing, a loss of about HK$41,000. Officers found a second unit in the same building had also been forced. Two men aged 29 and 39 living there later reported combined losses of about HK$6,600, including a watch, a mobile phone, a backpack and a suitcase. The three residents’ losses came to more than HK$47,000.

Kwun Tong crime officers searched the area and stopped a 53-year-old man in Sui Wo Building, about 40 metres away at 35 to 51 Ka Lok Street. Some of the missing property was recovered there, reports said. He was arrested on suspicion of handling stolen goods. The case remains under investigation.

zh.headline: 觀塘順景大樓兩單位遇竊 警在附近拙53歲男
zh.dek: 嘉樂街順景大樓兩個單位周四晚被擠門搜掠，三名住戶合共損失逾4.7萬元，警方其後在約40米外大廈截獲一名男子。
body: 警方周四晚上約8時接報，觀塘嘉樂街17至33號順景大樓一個單位大門被擠開，屋內有明顯搜掠痕跡。
一名52歲住戶向警方表示，單位內約3萬元現金、一條約值6,000元金頸鏈及一部約值5,000元平板電腦失竊，損失約4.1萬元。警員其後發現同幢另一單位同樣遭擠門。該單位兩名分別29歲及39歲男住戶事後點算，合共損失約6,600元財物，包括手錶、手提電話、背包及行李箱。兩單位三名住戶合計損失逾4.7萬元。
觀塘警區刑事調查隊在附近搜查，其後在約40米外嘉樂街35至51號瑞和大廈截獲一名53歲男子，並起回部分失物。該男子涉嫌處理贖物被捕，案件仍在調查。
